messages:
ravi: Hey folks — can someone take a look at PR #2148? It's a NovusBank private-deploy patch that fixes a VPC route reconciliation bug causing intermittent 502s. Hoping to merge before EOD. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2148

maya: On it, will run a quick review in ~1h. If it's small we can merge after CI.

sam: Quick skim: looks reasonable. One ask — can you add a unit test around the route cleanup function? Caught a similar edge case before.

ravi: Thanks — adding a small test now. Also added a note about the customer override flag (NOVUSBANK_OVERRIDE).

infra-bot: CI checks queued: lint, unit, integration, e2e. Current status: lint ✅, unit ❌ (tests failing), integration queued.

ravi: Fixed unit tests and pushed. PTAL @maya @sam

maya: Left two tiny comments in the diff (null-check and a docstring). Otherwise LGTM.

sam: I approved after the unit test landed. One more thing: can you include a brief changelog entry for the ops playbook?

jess: I can validate the deploy config once CI is green. Also double-check that the route table stays intact for the standby AZ.

infra-bot: CI update: unit ✅, integration ✅, e2e flaky (one unrelated timeout). Rerunning e2e.

infra-bot: CI update: e2e ✅ — all checks passed.

ravi: Added a 2-line changelog to the PR and pushed. Merging in 10m assuming no more issues. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Note: if merged before 22:00 UTC this will be in the next NovusBank canary roll (dev -> staging -> prod). Otherwise it'll land in the next scheduled patch window.

jess: Thanks — I'll watch the canary and validate health checks once it's in staging.

ravi: Merged. Thanks for the quick reviews everyone.

deploy-bot: Release job queued: novusbank-prod-1, job id rb-7782, ETA ~15m.

maya: cheers — great turnaround.
